info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Salesforce Tooling API
Salesforce Sales Cloud List available Tooling API sObjects

items.docs: Lists all available Tooling API sObjects and their metadata, including ApexClass, ApexTrigger, ApexComponent, ApexPage, ApexLog, MetadataContainer, and other developer-focused objects.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Get Tooling sObject basic information

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Tooling sObject (e.g., ApexClass, ApexTrigger)

items.docs: Retrieves basic metadata for the specified Tooling API sObject, including default field values and recently accessed records.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Create a Tooling sObject record

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Tooling sObject (e.g., ApexClass, ApexTrigger)

items.docs: Creates a new record for the specified Tooling API sObject. For example, creating an ApexClass record will create and compile a new Apex class in the org.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Get a Tooling sObject record

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Tooling sObject (e.g., ApexClass, ApexTrigger)

items.docs: Retrieves a Tooling API record by its ID. For example, retrieve an ApexClass record to get its source code, metadata, and compilation status.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Update a Tooling sObject record

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Tooling sObject (e.g., ApexClass, ApexTrigger)

items.docs: Updates an existing Tooling API record. For example, updating an ApexClass record will update and recompile the Apex class.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Delete a Tooling sObject record

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Tooling sObject (e.g., ApexClass, ApexTrigger)

items.docs: Deletes a Tooling API record by its ID.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Describe a Tooling sObject

params.name: sObjectName
params.description: The API name of the Tooling sObject (e.g., ApexClass, ApexTrigger)

items.docs: Completely describes the individual metadata for the specified Tooling API sObject, including all fields, child relationships, and other metadata attributes.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Execute a Tooling API SOQL query

params.name: q
params.value: SELECT Id, Name, Body FROM ApexClass WHERE NamespacePrefix = null
params.description: The SOQL query string targeting Tooling API objects

items.docs: Executes a SOQL query against Tooling API objects. Use this to query ApexClass, ApexTrigger, ApexLog, ApexTestQueueItem, and other Tooling API sObjects.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Get Apex code completions

params.name: type
params.description: The type of completions to return

items.docs: Returns code completions for Apex system type information. Useful for building IDE-like features for Salesforce development tools.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Execute anonymous Apex code

items.docs: Executes a block of anonymous Apex code. The code does not need to be part of an Apex class. Returns compilation and execution results, including any debug log output.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Run Apex tests asynchronously

items.docs: Runs one or more Apex test methods asynchronously. Returns the test run ID which can be used to check status and retrieve results.

info.name: Salesforce Sales Cloud Run Apex tests synchronously

items.docs: Runs specified Apex tests synchronously and returns the results inline. Best for small numbers of tests that complete quickly.
